artifacts.summary: Confirms two low-severity validate-mode defects: directory-path entries wrongly reported stale by a bare -f check, and SKILL.md's Validate Step 4 instructing users to pass a --dry-run flag that literature-normalize-authors.sh does not accept (dry-run is the flagless default). Both are doc/logic-only fixes in agent-system/extensions/literature/skills/skill-literature/SKILL.md; the normalize-authors script itself needs no change. Also verifies three adjacent findings (token-drift baseline, a mixed chunks_dir/path schema record for diamondsareforever, and a quarantine-artifact non-interaction with task 069's quality-gate hardening) as informational/follow-up only, out of this task's fix scope.
